questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the container wires per-request information into the services? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
What do the optional ContainerOverrides provide?
choices: A way to swap the clock and stores for fakes when building the container, such as in tests
Runtime hot-swapping of services after startup
A global registry that services can query lazily
